title: refactor: simplify media upload flow
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Simplifies catalog upload plumbing by removing a redundant tag-error wrapper, unused insert return value, and duplicate response state.
- Derives authentication directly from API keys in the packaging and makeup apps.
- Removes unreachable upload-source and response-shape fallbacks while preserving canonical media URLs and tags.
- Removes 51 net lines across the service and its consumers; supersedes #12961.

Checks:
- Biome on all four changed files
- Media Worker integration suite: 29 tests
- Packaging app TypeScript and production build
- Virtual Makeup production build

gist.headline: Less plumbing, same pixels
gist.blurb: The media upload pipes got a quiet cleanup: fewer wrappers, fewer duplicate states, and the same canonical images arriving where they belong. Polli found 51 lines hiding behind the shed.
gist.summary: Simplified catalog media uploads across the Media Worker, Product Packaging Designer, and Virtual Makeup apps by deriving auth from API keys and removing redundant error, response-state, and unreachable fallback handling.
gist.impact: Packaging and makeup uploads retain their canonical media URLs and tags while the clients and service share a smaller, more direct upload path.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy garden irrigation system that represents media-upload plumbing: several unnecessary pipe loops have been removed, leaving one clear pipe from two creative app stations to a catalog garden. A tiny retro terminal shows a key icon flowing directly into a photo-tagged seed packet, while code-plants and labeled image tiles make the preserved URL-and-tag path visible.
